caption: The first kernel shrinks from 11×11 to 7×7 to 3×3 while the networks get deeper; the first convolution's parameters fall from 34,944 to 14,208 to 1,792. The highlighted endpoints are AlexNet and VGG16.

spec.title: First conv: smaller kernels, fewer weights
spec.aria: A chain from AlexNet to ZFNet to VGG16 shows first kernels 11 by 11 stride 4, 7 by 7 stride 2, and 3 by 3 pad 1, with 8, 8, and 16 weight layers and first-convolution parameter counts 34,944, 14,208, and 1,792.
